difficulty_reason: The stalkwise reduction and both implication arguments are written in the span. (2)=>(1): for each x the stalk is a free O_{X,x}-module of rank > 0, and the proof states the depth computation depth(F_x) = dim(O_{X,x}) justified by the regular local ring being Cohen-Macaulay (named Algebra citation); full support is immediate from pointwise nonzero free stalks. (1)=>(2): the hypothesis makes F_x a maximal Cohen-Macaulay module over the regular local ring O_{X,x} (the proof names the definition), and freeness follows from the cited algebra lemma that maximal Cohen-Macaulay modules over regular local rings are free; freeness of stalks of a coherent module gives finite locally free. Only the two standard local-algebra inputs are cited; the geometric argument is self-contained.

dedup.scope: Cohen-Macaulay coherent modules on regular schemes are exactly the positive-rank finite locally free ones.
